name: District of Columbia
agencyName: District of Columbia Department of Motor Vehicles

gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: 18 (full license); intermediate stage until 21 or completion
gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 40 hours in learner stage; 10 night hours in intermediate stage
gdl.nightCurfew: Learner: no driving 9 p.m.-6 a.m. Intermediate (Sept-June): 11 p.m.-6 a.m. Sun-Thu and 12:01 a.m.-6 a.m. Fri-Sat; (July-Aug): 12:01 a.m.-6 a.m.
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months of provisional license: no passengers under 21 except immediate family or a driving instructor; restrictions ease afterward

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. birth certificate or passport)
process.realIdNotes: A REAL ID credential requires proof of identity/date of birth, proof of SSN, and two proofs of DC residency. A Limited Purpose (non-REAL ID) credential is also available.
process.licenseFee: $47 (8-year full license); $20 provisional license; knowledge test $10 at a DC DMV service center ($39.95 proctoring center / $49.95 virtual)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 10-11 points: 90-day suspension; 12 or more points: license revocation
facts.moveOverRule: Slow down and, when safe, move over a lane for stopped emergency, tow, and service vehicles displaying flashing lights

references.label: DC DMV Driver Manual
references.citation: District of Columbia DMV Driver Manual

verifyNote: Official DC DMV sources confirm the age-based test lengths (under 21: 30; age 21+: 25), $10 service-center test fee, $20 permit/provisional fees, $47 eight-year license fee, minimum age 16, six-month/40-hour learner requirements, BAC limits, and point thresholds. The official pages available in this review did not explicitly state the 24/30 and 20/25 passing scores, and the current manual edition year and seasonal provisional curfew wording remain unconfirmed.
